description.zh: 云剪辑工程封面。如果为空且时间线上的video轨已经存在素材，则默认选取时间线上第一个素材封面。
description.en: The thumbnail of the online editing project. If this parameter is left empty and materials exist in the video track of the timeline, the thumbnail of the first material in the timeline is used as the thumbnail of the online editing project.
The description of the online editing project.
The region where the service is activated.

description.zh:
云剪辑工程时间线。JSON格式。具体结构定义，请参见[Timeline](~~52839~~)。

当该字段为空时，则创建一个空的时间线，且云剪辑工程的总时长为0。
description.en:
The timeline of the online editing project. The value must be a JSON string. For more information about the data structure, see [Timeline](~~52839~~).

If this parameter is left empty, an empty timeline is created and the total duration of the online editing project is 0.
The title of the online editing project.

descriptions.zh: - 更多有关云剪辑的详细内容，请参见[云剪辑](~~95482~~)。
descriptions.en: - For more information about online editing, see [Online editing](~~95482~~).
